description: Caller cannot give the policy number; hit-and-run, so third-party details are unknown.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Good morning, Horizon Assurance, Nadia speaking.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Hello, someone hit my car while it was parked and just drove off. I want to make a claim.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I'm sorry about that. Do you have your policy number?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I don't, it's on the papers in the glovebox and the car is at the garage. I really don't have it with me.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: That's fine, we can add it later. What's your name?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Amina El Idrissi.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: And the registration of the car?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: When did it happen?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Last Saturday night, around eleven. I came back to the car and the door was smashed.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Saturday the nineteenth, around 11 pm. Where was the car parked?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: In the car park of the Marjane supermarket in Hay Riad, in Rabat.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: What's the damage?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: The rear right door is dented and badly scratched, and the handle is broken.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Was anyone in the car? Anyone hurt?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No, nobody was in the car, nobody was hurt.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Do you know anything about the vehicle that hit you?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No, nothing. A guard said the plate maybe started with 12, but he wasn't sure. They just drove away.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Did you report it to the police?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes, I went to the police station this morning. They gave me a receipt with the number 2026/RB/7781.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: 2026/RB/7781, noted. What number should we call you back on?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: My number is plus 212 6 62 48 19 07.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Thank you Mrs El Idrissi. Please send us the policy number when you can.
